name: month rollover, years 1950-1979 (transfer set)
arch: gpt2: a pre-trained decoder-only transformer language model (12 layers, 12 heads per layer, d_model 768, d_head 64, d_mlp 3072, vocabulary 50257; pre-LayerNorm blocks: resid += attn(ln1(resid)); resid += mlp(ln2(resid)); logits = ln_f(resid) @ W_U; learned absolute position embeddings; GELU).

domain.text: Each prompt is "<month1> <year> - <month2>", a date range whose end year is to be predicted, for example "March 1987 - January". x[:, 0] = month1 and x[:, 1] = month2 as indices 0..11 (0 = January ... 11 = December); x[:, 2] = the year (1950..1979). Every pair of months occurs with every year. Token positions: 0 <|endoftext|>, 1 month1, 2 the year, 3 " -", 4 month2 (the last token). Roles: m1 = 1, year = 2, dash = 3, m2 = end = 4. The network's output is three logits at the end position: of the year token itself ("same year"), of the next year ("next year") and of the year before ("previous year"); these tokens differ from prompt to prompt.

context: The prompts are date ranges; the answer is the year in which the range ends.

answer.short: GPT-2 small mostly continues with the same year when month2 comes after month1 in the calendar, and with the next year when it comes before; the probability of the next year grows with the forward distance from month1 to month2.
